svg.text: Broadcom software paths across the VCF fleet
The Software Depot fetches through the customer proxy and feeds VCF. The admin host fetches PAIS content separately and mirrors it to an optional Harbor.
Requested by the Software Depot, and by VMDT
Manual workflows; its own proxy settings
Holds binaries and OVFs; exposes an OCI registry interface
and pushes them to a Harbor project
1 PAIS mirrored to an optional Harbor requires the external PAIS YAML definition; AMT generates the installation and service configuration YAML files.
Sources are representative, not a complete network allowlist. Management arrows do not prove an instance-level staging sequence.
Connected mode above; the admin host's VMDT uploads and PAIS AMT mirroring are separate workflows with distinct purposes.
